Class CockroachDBRegions

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.data.transaction.CockroachDBRegions
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.transaction.TransactionExecutionListener
public class CockroachDBRegions extends Object implements org.springframework.transaction.TransactionExecutionListener
Binds the resolved region for each transaction that a @Transactional, @CockroachDBTransactional or CockroachDBTransactionTemplate call begins, so REGIONAL BY ROW rows written in that transaction are homed to it.

Those callers bind a scope on the current thread for the length of the call. When a transaction begins inside that scope, this listener publishes the region to RegionContext for the duration of the transaction; RegionalByRowListener then stamps the entity's @CrdbRegion column on @PrePersist. (CockroachDB has no SET crdb_region session variable, so the region is never applied as session SQL.) The region is the first of:

  1. the region the caller bound explicitly (@CockroachDBTransactional(region = ...) or CockroachDBTransactionTemplate.setRegion(...));
  2. RegionContext;
  3. the RegionResolver bean;
  4. cockroachdb.region.default-region.
No region, a suppressed scope, or a transaction begun outside such a scope leaves RegionContext untouched. The starter registers this listener with every ConfigurableTransactionManager bean.

      public static CockroachDBRegions.Scope bind(String explicitRegion)

      public static CockroachDBRegions.Scope suppress()
